QuestInfo.name: Gettin' Cozy with Clara
QuestInfo.1: Clara wants a big stash of Valentine's Coins she can use to give to her friends. Maybe you two can become closer if you help her out!
QuestInfo.2: You helped Clara with her Valentine's chores, and now you're pals (and maybe more)!
